title_en: 11oz Coffee Mug with Candy Cane Accents, Hot Cocoa. Side Of Joy Two-Sided Print Ceramic Cup, White Black Pink Red Blue Inside, Microwave & Dishwasher Safe, Sarcastic Office Gift
bullets_en: BOLD SLOGAN ARTWORK - "HOT COCOA. SIDE OF JOY" printed on both sides in heavy block lettering, rich red ink that stays crisp wash after wash
5 INTERIOR COLORS - choose White, Black, Pink, Red, or Blue interior; glossy white exterior suits every kitchen and desk
PREMIUM 11oz CERAMIC - 11 oz / 330 ml, food-grade glaze, safe for dishwasher and microwave
GIFT-READY - a laugh-out-loud present for coworkers, friends, moms and dads with a sense of humor, for birthdays, office gift exchanges, or just because
EVERYDAY FRIENDLY - comfortable C-shaped handle, works for coffee, tea, milk, hot cocoa, hot or cold drinks
description_en:
Say it without saying it: this 11 oz ceramic mug carries the line "Hot Cocoa. Side Of Joy" in bold red type on both sides, so the joke lands no matter which way the handle faces. Glossy white body, your choice of interior color, and a print baked for long-lasting color. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Packed securely for safe delivery.

Perfect for the coworker, friend, or family member whose sense of humor runs straight through the coffee break.
